thread:
devon: Drafting QuantumBridge private offer for marketplace + SI co-sell. Key asks: multi-year step-up commit, HW credit allocation between partner and Sierra SI, renewal "on-invoice" mechanics, and marketplace SKU gating. Quick takes? @sara @vikram
sara: Love the step-up idea. Low friction entry band = $35k. Suggest 3-year stepped commit: Yr1 50%, Yr2 +25%, Yr3 +25% (of target).
vikram: Sales: add $30k POC pool for named prospects and a usage floor (50% of first-year commit) to qualify for renewal credits. Also require named-customer list for SI credits.
legal: Legal: export/customs check for HW credits. Need explicit wording: "appliance credits issued as on-invoice line item after deployment; subject to export clearance." Also include 45-day opt-out during onboarding window.
finance-bot: Finance note: propose discounts 9%/15%/23% for $35k/$275k/$1.1M bands. Renewal credits applied as on-invoice credits, capped at 30% of next-year invoice. Attach cost-model when posting margin calc.
anna: Ops: private deployment onboarding = VPC 3w + on-prem 5w. If we promise step-ups we need auto-scale reservations mapped to SKU tiers.
devon: Quick draft PO snippet below, keep comments brief:
```
QuantumBridge x Redwood Private Offer (draft)
Bands:
- Starter: $35,000 commit -> 9% discount, $30k POC credits, 6mo activation window
- Growth: $275,000 commit -> 15% discount, 10% on-invoice renewal credit, 9mo activation window
- Scale: $1,100,000 commit -> 23% discount, 18% on-invoice renewal credit, 12mo activation window
Multi-year step-up: 3-year target with Yr1=50%, Yr2=75%, Yr3=100% billing measurement; renewal credits prorated annually; failure to hit Yr2 step reduces next-year credit by 50%
HW credit: up to $150k appliance credit per account; split: 60% allocated to SI enablement (Sierra) and 40% to partner GTM; invoices credited after deployment and export clearance
Trial pool: $30k non-transferable, expires 90 days; gated to named prospects
Marketplace SKU mapping: Starter -> public token SKU; Growth/Scale -> reserved-capacity SKU + private listing for SI-enabled deals
Renewal mechanics: credits applied as on-invoice line item; capped at 30% of next-year invoice; must meet usage floor to redeem; unused trial not counted toward commit
GTM: joint announcement upon 3 paid go-lives; partner co-marketing fund $40k on Scale 12mo commit
```
sara: Agree but ask to clarify step-up measurement window and whether credits carry over if customer overachieves.
vikram: Sales wants a small acceleration credit for customers who exceed target by >20% in Yr2. Can we add a 5% bonus credit?
legal: I'll add the export clause and opt-out redline by Thu. Also will request clear language on credit timing (post-deployment invoice).
finance-bot: I'll run margin model and post blended margin per band + net effective price by EOD. Attach cost sheet when ready.
anna: I'll map SKUs to reserved capacity names and share runbook links. Need partner SI contact to scope enablement.
devon: Actions: @legal redline, @finance-bot margin + cost model, @anna SKU mapping + runbook, @vikram sales gating list. Partner sync Fri 10am PT. Thanks.
